name: mail-rocket
description: Self-hosted email campaigns over AWS SES: the API (apps/api) and the web app (apps/web).

scripts.install:all: bun install --cwd apps/api && bun install --cwd apps/web
scripts.dev: bun run dev:api & bun run dev:web & wait
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/api && bunx tsc --noEmit -p . && cd ../web && bunx next typegen && bunx tsc --noEmit -p .
